sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Core Sites

  • Pataliputra: Palatial remains, wooden fortifications.
  • Barabar Caves: Earliest rock-cut caves (Ajivikas).
  • Sanchi: Stupa foundations.

Currency System

  • Punch-Marked Coins (Silver/Copper).
  • Symbols: Sun, six-armed wheel, crescent.
  • Standardization via state minting.
  • Archaeological Sites:
    • NBPW as a distinct material culture signature.
    • Ashokan Pillars: Evidence of Mauryan lithic skill and administrative reach.
    • Barabar Caves: Proves religious patronage (Ajivikas).
  • Coinage Analysis:
    • Types: Pana (Silver), Ardha-pana.
    • Standardization: Mentioned in Arthashastra as 'Lakshana-adhyaksha' (Superintendent of Mint).
SourceSignificance
Punch-Marked CoinsCommercial integration of the subcontinent.
NBPW SitesUrbanization markers.
